name: shiploop
description: Session harness: spec once, one backchain sequence plan, then walk ready steps by printing a parent until-loop per running id in a per-step git worktree/branch. Use when the user says shiploop, ship the project, session harness, or what's the next step. After every increment invoke /shiploop complete — do not rely on chat memory. Lost context without completing → /shiploop next. Issue this prompt — satisfy the printed precondition, exec When done exactly, until When done says stop (done / halted / blocked-ask).
